module Jekyll
  module Drops
    class DocumentDrop < Drop
      extend Forwardable

      NESTED_OBJECT_FIELD_BLACKLIST = %w(
        content output excerpt next previous
      ).freeze

      mutable false

      delegate_method_as :relative_path, :path
      private delegate_method_as :data, :fallback_data

      delegate_methods :id, :output, :content, :to_s, :relative_path, :url, :date
      data_delegators "title", "categories", "tags"

      def collection
        @obj.collection.label
      end

      def excerpt
        fallback_data["excerpt"].to_s
      end

      def <=>(other)
        return nil unless other.is_a? DocumentDrop

        cmp = self["date"] <=> other["date"]
        cmp = self["path"] <=> other["path"] if cmp.nil? || cmp.zero?
        cmp
      end

      def previous
        @obj.previous_doc.to_liquid
      end

      def next
        @obj.next_doc.to_liquid
      end

      # Generate a Hash for use in generating JSON.
      # This is useful if fields need to be cleared before the JSON can generate.
      #
      # state - the JSON::State object which determines the state of current processing.
      #
      # Returns a Hash ready for JSON generation.
      def hash_for_json(state = nil)
        to_h.tap do |hash|
          if state && state.depth >= 2
            hash["previous"] = collapse_document(hash["previous"]) if hash["previous"]
            hash["next"]     = collapse_document(hash["next"]) if hash["next"]
          end
        end
      end

      # Generate a Hash which breaks the recursive chain.
      # Certain fields which are normally available are omitted.
      #
      # Returns a Hash with only non-recursive fields present.
      def collapse_document(doc)
        doc.keys.each_with_object({}) do |(key, _), result|
          result[key] = doc[key] unless NESTED_OBJECT_FIELD_BLACKLIST.include?(key)
        end
      end

      def read_source(opts = {})
        document = @obj
        Jekyll.logger.debug "Reading:", document.relative_path

        if Document::YAML_FILE_EXTS.include?(File.extname(document.path))
          document.instance_variable_set(:@data, SafeYAML.load_file(document.path))
          return
        end

        site = document.site
        collection = document.collection
        begin
          defaults = site.frontmatter_defaults.all(
            document.relative_path,
            collection.label.to_sym
          )
          unless defaults.empty?
            document.merge_data!(defaults, :source => "front matter defaults")
          end

          document.content = File.read(
            document.path,
            **Utils.merged_file_read_opts(site, opts)
          )
          if document.content =~ Document::YAML_FRONT_MATTER_REGEXP
            document.content = Regexp.last_match.post_match
            data_file = SafeYAML.load(Regexp.last_match(1))
            document.merge_data!(data_file, :source => "YAML front matter") if data_file
          end

          document.post_read
        rescue StandardError => error
          if error.is_a? Psych::SyntaxError
            Jekyll.logger.error "Error:",
                                "YAML Exception reading #{document.path}: #{error.message}"
          else
            Jekyll.logger.error "Error:",
                                "could not read file #{document.path}: #{error.message}"
          end

          strict = site.config["strict_front_matter"]
          raise error if strict || error.is_a?(Jekyll::Errors::FatalException)
        end
      end
      private :read_source
    end
  end
end
